messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: INC-2001 — synthetic/canary check failure (eu-west-1 canary group). 5/5 probes failed in the last 2 minutes. Link: https://redwood.ops/incidents/INC-2001 :rotating_light:

pagerduty: PagerDuty: INC-2001 has been fired and notified the SRE on-call schedule.

SRE-Oncall: Acked INC-2001. I’m looking at the canary dashboard now. ETA 5m to initial triage.

maya: I see the canary agent returning 403s for the probe requests — weird. Production customer traffic metrics look fine (0.2% p50 error spike, nothing widespread).

jonathan: Noted. Any config deploys around the time the probes started?

maya: There was a small auth token rotation for the canary service at 09:12 UTC. Ops notes show new token pushed to k8s secret eu-canary/token.

SRE-Oncall: Can we confirm the canary binaries actually picked up the new secret? Running a quick curl against the canary endpoint from within the eu-west probe pod: ```bash
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CANARY_TOKEN' https://canary.eu-west.redwood.ai/health
```

sam: Running that now in the probe pod — getting HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden with response body: "token invalid or expired".

lina: That matches: the rotation job updated the secret but the probe-sidecar wasn't restarted. The probes use mounted secret volumes, need a rolling restart to pick up new tokens.

SRE-Oncall: Good catch. For immediate mitigation we can roll the canary probe daemonset on eu-west only to pick up the new secret. That should be quick. Do we want to pause synthetic alarms until restart completes?

jonathan: Pause alarms AND temporarily disable fanout to reduce noisy pages. Fanout to other regions is causing duplicate alerts. ops-bot can toggle route? @ops-bot can you run the route-toggle playbook to disable canary fanout?

ops-bot: Executing playbook: route-toggle --target canary-fanout --region eu-west --action disable.

ops-bot: Done — fanout to apac and us-west paused for canary probes. :white_check_mark:

SRE-Oncall: Rolling restart of the canary probe daemonset in eu-west now: ```bash
kubectl rollout restart daemonset/canary-probes -n infra-eu-west --selector=component=probe
```

maya: Restart triggered. Pods are terminating and recreating. First new pod shows 200 OK on health check now.

pagerduty: INC-2001 acknowledged by SRE-Oncall at 2026-02-11T09:27:12Z. No further escalation will occur while incident is acknowledged.

SRE-Oncall: Observation: after restart, 4/5 probes recovered, one still failing due to a pod hung in CrashLoopBackOff. Investigating crash logs.

sam: Crash log snippet from failing probe pod: ```
Error: failed to refresh token: context deadline exceeded
stack: at probe/refresh.ts:87
```

jonathan: That looks like an intermittent network call to vault timing out. Could be transient. I'll bounce the pod once more.

jonathan: Replaced pod, now all 5/5 probes show OK. Synthetic alert back to normal.

SRE-Oncall: Great — re-enabling fanout and unpausing alarms. ops-bot re-enable?

ops-bot: Executing playbook: route-toggle --target canary-fanout --region eu-west --action enable.

ops-bot: Fanout re-enabled. Alarms unpaused.

SRE-Oncall: Summary so far: root cause = token rotation applied but probe sidecars didn’t pick up rotated secret (mounted volume requires restart). Secondary: one probe pod hit a transient token refresh timeout (network to Vault). Mitigation = rolling restart of probe daemonset + pod replacement; paused fanout to stop duplicate alerts.

lina: Customer impact: none observed. Production request rates and error budgets unchanged. This was limited to synthetic probes. No post-login flows impacted per tracing. Marking severity: SEV3 (synthetic-only).

SRE-Oncall: Handoff: I'm handing off to jonathan for follow-up (vault network checks, consider adding readiness check for token refresh, and adjust rotation runbook). I’ll remain on call for 15m in case of regression.

jonathan: Taking over. Action items I’ll own: 1) add a post-rotation rolling restart step for probe daemonsets; 2) add exponential backoff + retry to token refresh in probe; 3) investigate vault-ha latency in eu-west.

maya: I'll open a short post-rotation checklist PR with the restart step and notify the release engineers.

sam: Logging note: will add a more explicit 401 vs 403 differentiation in probe logs for easier triage next time.

pagerduty: INC-2001 resolved by SRE-Oncall at 2026-02-11T09:36:40Z.

SRE-Oncall: Closing notes: no customer-facing impact, runbook gap found (missing restart), mitigations applied, follow-ups assigned. Will draft a short incident blameless summary in #postmortems with timeline and RCA. :memo:

maya: Thanks team.

jonathan: Thanks, closing my side tasks after the vault checks.

sam: will add log change in a small PR today.

 incident-bot: Incident INC-2001 has been marked RESOLVED.
